There is a bug currently when there are more than one VLAN defined
and any reset that affects the PF is initiated
no traffic will pass on any VLAN but the last one created.
This is caused by the iteration though the VLANs during replay each
clearing the vsi_map bitmap of the VSI that is being replayed.  The
problem is that during rhe replay
column2: the pointer to the vsi_map bitmap

column1: is used by each successive vlan to determine if it should be replayed
on this VSI.
The logic was that the replay of the VLAN would replace the bit in the map
before the next VLAN would iterate through.  But
the old bitmap pointer to filt_replay_rules and creates a new one for the
recreated VLANS
column3: and leaves the old bitmap broken

column1: to be used to replay the remaining VLANs.
Since the old bitmap will be cleaned up in post replay cleanup
no need to alter it and break following VLAN replay
bit.
